content:
RORK — COMPLETE IVX 112 IA TO REAL 10/10 NOW

1. Change executeAgentRun() so it cannot complete a task using only produceAgentOutput(...).
2. Require every agent to use at least 1 real permitted tool when the task requires external data.
3. Add required execution fields:
   - realToolUsed
   - sourceReference
   - toolResultId
   - verifiedOutput
4. FAIL any execution that has no verifiable source.
5. Remove all old references to “100 agents”.
6. Enforce totalAgents === 112.
7. Enforce 112 unique agentNumber values.
8. Enforce 112 unique agentId values.
9. Enforce all 112 agents are active.
10. Enforce recent heartbeat for all 112.
11. FAIL if any agent is offline, disabled, paused, unknown, or unhealthy.
12. Persist execution state in Supabase, not RAM only.
13. Persist lastHeartbeat.
14. Persist lastSuccessfulRun.
15. Persist lastFailedRun.
16. Persist toolsUsed.
17. Persist evidence.
18. Persist sourceReference.
19. Persist output.
20. Persist costUsage.
21. Persist taskId.
22. Persist finalStatus.
23. Connect IA-17 Investor Acquisition to real permitted lead sources.
24. Require IA-17 leads to include verifiable sources.
25. Connect IA-19 Buyer Acquisition to real permitted buyer sources.
26. Require IA-19 buyer results to include verifiable sources.
27. Connect IA-20 Buyer Qualification to the real CRM.
28. Make IA-20 score buyers using real data.
29. Connect IA-21 Buyer Follow-Up to the real CRM.
30. Keep external outreach behind approval/compliance gates.
31. Connect IA-27 Partnership Development to real company/business sources.
32. Require IA-27 partner results to include source URLs/references.
33. Connect IA-28 JV Deal Origination to real data sources.
34. Require IA-28 JV opportunities to be verifiable.
35. Connect IA-31 Tokenized Assets to real research sources.
36. Require jurisdiction + source for every tokenization opportunity.
37. Connect IA-32 Tokenized Deal Research to real research sources.
38. Block any securities/legal approval claim unless independently reviewed.
39. Do not use Landing 112-Agent Autonomous QA War Room as proof of real work.
40. Keep that workflow only for advisory/QA.
41. Create new workflow:
    IVX 112 Real Execution Certificate
42. Execute all 112 agents in that workflow.
43. Require realToolUsed=true for every agent.
44. Require sourceReference for every agent.
45. Require evidence for every agent.
46. Produce 112 individual evidence artifacts.
47. Produce final summary 112/112 PASS.
48. If even 1 agent fails, full certificate must FAIL.
49. Add restart/redeploy persistence test.
50. Verify state survives restart.
51. Verify pending tasks survive restart.
52. Verify retries do not duplicate tasks.
53. Verify deduplication.
54. Verify per-agent timeout policy.
55. Verify per-agent retry policy.
56. Verify per-agent cost limits.
57. Verify per-agent tool permissions.
58. Verify agents cannot use prohibited tools.
59. Verify cross-agent memory isolation.
60. Verify cross-company/division data isolation.
61. Add endpoint:
    /api/ivx/agents/certificate
62. Endpoint must return total=112.
63. Endpoint must return healthy=112.
64. Endpoint must return realExecutionVerified=112.
65. Endpoint must return evidenceVerified=112.
66. Endpoint must return persistenceVerified=true.
67. Endpoint must return simulatedRuns=0 for certified runs.
68. Endpoint must return exact production commit SHA.
69. Endpoint must return certification timestamp.
70. Endpoint must return runtime version.
71. Run live verification against https://api.ivxholding.com.
72. Confirm production is running the exact certified SHA.
73. Confirm Render is not running an older version.
74. Confirm required runtime variables are actually loaded.
75. Do not request new credentials unless current credentials are proven missing/expired/revoked.
76. If an integration returns 401/403, log the exact runtime identity/credential binding used.
77. If one integration is unavailable, block only affected agents.
78. Never mark an agent completed if its real tool failed.
79. Never replace external tool failure with synthetic output.
80. Never return fake success fallback.
81. Store exact source URL/reference for public-source research.
82. Store CRM record ID for created leads.
83. Store dedup key for each prospect.
84. Prevent duplicate buyers/investors.
85. Add objective scoring.
86. Separate buyer prospects from investor prospects.
87. Separate investor prospects from tokenized-asset prospects.
88. Apply compliance gates to investor outreach.
89. Apply compliance gates to tokenized opportunities.
90. Keep money movement prohibited.
91. Keep trade execution prohibited.
92. Keep legal execution prohibited.
93. Keep production deploy behind appropriate approval.
94. Build 112/112 live status dashboard.
95. Show per agent:
    - running
    - blocked
    - failed
    - completed
96. Show last real tool used.
97. Show last source used.
98. Show last evidence.
99. Show last heartbeat.
100. Show execution duration.
101. Show real errors.
102. Show retry count.
103. Show cost.
104. Alert if heartbeat becomes stale.
105. Alert if an agent becomes stuck.
106. Alert if output exists without evidence.
107. Alert if an agent attempts a prohibited tool.
108. Create end-to-end buyer acquisition test.
109. Create end-to-end investor research test.
110. Create end-to-end tokenized research test.
111. Create end-to-end CRM persistence test.
112. FINAL CERTIFICATE ONLY PASSES WHEN:
     - 112/112 agents real
     - 112/112 evidence verified
     - 112/112 persistent
     - 112/112 healthy
     - 112/112 unique
     - 0 simulated certified runs
     - exact production SHA verified
     - live API verification PASS

DO NOT CLAIM 10/10 BEFORE ALL ABOVE PASS WITH REAL EVIDENCE.
